title: 전체 개발 이력 읽기 전용 Git 메타데이터 원장

crossYearFixture.description: 서로 다른 연도·저장소의 커밋과 날짜형 요약 제목을 full hash와 ISO 시각으로 식별한다. ERP 차수·MSSQL 원장을 조회하거나 수정하지 않는다.

dnspyEvidence.source: nenova.exe 대응 기능이 아닌 웹 전용 정적 Git 메타데이터 조회. EXE 및 SQL에 접근하지 않는다.
methods: NenovaWeb withAuth GET static snapshot read

counting.unit: verified default-ref reachable Git commit record, not user request or hours
counting.global: exact full-hash union across source repositories; work summaries separate
counting.merge: parent count greater than one; counted separately from non-merge
counting.stage: external verified main refs plus current ERP build HEAD; ERP non-master build HEAD may include branch commits, explicitly disclosed; no working tree
counting.classification: parentless verified root or explicit subject prefix; otherwise unclassified
counting.safety: sanitized subject and allowlisted paths only; no author identity, body, diff, private session content, SQL, or ERP data
